title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Share of Guaranty Carried Forward after a Partial Claim Cure
content:
On a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan assumed by a buyer, the guaranty carried forward depends on how recently a partial claim cured a default on the loan, read from the date of the latest partial claim entry in the loan's money transactions.

## Cure share

| Latest partial claim on the loan paid | Share of the guaranty carried forward |
|---|---|
| Less than 12 months before today | The recent-cure share, 90 percent |
| At least 12 months but less than 36 months before today | The older-cure share, 95 percent |
| Otherwise (36 months or more before today, or no partial claim ever paid) | The whole of it, 100 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, in months before today)

| Months since the latest partial claim | Share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 90 |
| 11 | 90 |
| 12 | 95 |
| 35 | 95 |
| 36 | 100 |
| No partial claim | 100 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A guaranty of 60,000.00 dollars on a loan whose latest partial claim was paid 8 months before today is carried forward at 90 percent: 60,000.00 multiplied by 90 and divided by one hundred, or 54,000.00 dollars.
